scripts.dev: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm -r --if-present build && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:api: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm -r --if-present build && node apps/api/dist/server.js
scripts.typecheck: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm --filter @modernizer/contracts build && vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm contracts:generate && pnpm -r --if-present build && node tests/e2e/local-smoke.mjs
